create_MlirEnv_default: create an MlirEnv instance with default benchmark and runtime reward settings
create_MlirEnv_custom_benchmark: create an MlirEnv instance with a custom MatmulBenchmark and datasets site path
reset_MlirEnv: reset the MlirEnv environment and resend runtimes per observation count
set_runtime_observation_count: set the runtime observation count on an MlirEnv instance during an episode
step_MlirEnv: take a single optimization step in the MlirEnv with an action and observation spaces
